# Independent conformance fixtures

`publication-contract-v1.json` defines neutral input edits and explicit expected
consumer outcomes for the three supported schemas. Expected results are
independent data; never generate them from production parser results.
Builders create only synthetic repositories; standard-library hashes supply
valid approval inputs. Positive cases assert exact ordered file admissions.

Coverage includes approval states, path rules, exact-byte approval, package
metadata, notebook dependencies/settings and content policy. Passing does not
approve real content. Sharing with producer repositories is separate work.
Change corpus versions deliberately when supported contract semantics change.
